martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Sunday evening is looking perfect for a run, around 19:00–21:00 the temperature cools down to a lovely 21°C with barely any rain, making it ideal. You might even convince Britt to join you for a bit, or use it as an excuse to relax together afterwards. The midday heat is a bit much, but if you time it right, it should be a great outing.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Sunday funday is calling — great running conditions from 19:00 to 21:00, perfect time to get some exercise before unwinding with Martha. The temperature will be around 21°C, ideal for a run, and it's dry, so no excuses. If you're both up for it, a sunset run followed by a drink on the terrace sounds like a great way to cap off the weekend.
